rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 39(A)(1) OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 226, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS INVESTMENTS CODE OF 1987, AS AMENDED(RE: TWELVE YEARS INCOME TAX HOLIDAY FOR A REGISTERED PIONEER ENTERPRISE BASED ON SEVERAL CONDITIONS)
rows.abstract: A REGISTERED PIONEER ENTERPRISE MAY BE GRANTED A MAXIMUM OF TWELVE YEARS INCOME TAX HOLIDAY SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE SECRETARY OF FINANCE, AND COMPLIANCE BY THE REGISTRED PIONEER ENTERPRISE, WITH ALL THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS: (A) THE PROJECT WILL MANUFACTURE PRODUCTS  THAT ARE DISTINCTLY AND COMPLETELY NEW IN THE PHILIPPINE AND WILL BE LARGELY FOR EXPORTS OR WHICH ARE ESSENTIAL RAW MATERIALS, PARTS AND/OR COMPONENTS OF THE COUNTRY'S SIGNIFICANT EXPORTS; (B) THE PROJECT WILL REQUIRE A NEWINVESTMENT OF AT LEAST ONE BILLION US DOLLARS (US $1,000,000,00); (C) THE PROJECT WILL CREATE HIGH DOMESTIC ALUE-ADDED; (D) THE PROJECT WILL STRENGTHEN WORLD-COMPETETI VENESS OF DOWNSTREAM AND RELATED INDUSTRIAL AND SERVICE SECTORS; AND (E) THE PROJEECT WILL LEAD TO ACQUISITION BY FILIPINO WORKERS OF HIGHLY ADVANCED TECHNOLOGICAL SKILLS AND EXPERTISE BY WORLD STRANDARDS.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10596

rows.abstract: "Groundwater Extraction Act". Rationale: Water resources within the territorial jurisdiction of the Republic of the Philippines belong to the State, and their appropriation of rights over their use for any purpose allowed by law is a privilege granted to citizens by the government. Pursuant to this, the State has the right to manage, control and regulate the use of its waters in order to ensure that the exercise of water rights by others does not prejudice the rights of the rest of the populace.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF INSTRUMENTATION AND CONTROL ENGINEERING IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Philippine Instrumentation and Control Engineering Law of 1999". Rationale: Today, with the continued innovation in technology and the development of industrial standards of excellence (e.g. ISO ratings), INSTRUMENT AND CONTROL ENGINEERS and TECHNICIANS are called upon to innovate and improve their level of competence and professional integrity. Their stewardship of a crucial cog in the world's industrial process require nothing less. Equally so, the State must now initiate the enactment of alaw that will PROFESSIONALIZE the practice and control of instrumentation and control engineering in the country. This will, part, guarantee the compliance of practitioners in this engineering discipline with the demands of competitive and highly innnovative profession.

rows.abstract: Rationale: The tax exemption of the SSS and the GSIS give them an advantage over other investment houses and pension funds when they participate in the capital market. The tax exemption gives them higher profits in their investents and this allows them a wider room in making deals. To level the playing field, this bill proposes to tax the investment of the SSS and GSIS. They will be subject to taxes such as capital gains tax and stock transaction tax, 20% final tax on deposits just like any other corporation.

rows.author: C029
rows.title_full: AN ACT RESTORING THE TAX EXEMPTION PRIVILEGES OF LOCAL WATER DISTRICTS UNDER SECTION 46 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 198 AS AMENDED AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Water is basic to man's needs.  The government should continually support the water industry, which requires MASSIVE INVESTMENT OUTLAY WITH LONG GESTATION PERIOD OF RECOVERY - 50 YEARS OR MORE, BEFORE THE INIITIAL INVESTMENT IS RECOVERED. To incorporate the taxes waived in the oeprating cost will place the water district in bad light and with their services at stake.  For the good of society, our people should have continuous and convenient acess to water facilities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1999-11-09

rows.author: C022
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING COOPERATIVES TO IMPORT AND RETAIL GASOLINE AND OTHER PETROLEUM PRODUCTS FOR RETAIL TO THEIR RESPECTIVE MEMBERS ALLOWING THESE ENTITIES TO USE THEIR SURPLUS TO FUND SUCH VENTURE, AND DIRECTING GOVERNMENT FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS TO GIVE PRIORITY APPROVAL TO LOANS FOR SUCH UNDERTAKING SO AS TO ATTAIN THE PURPOSE OF THIS ACT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The Constitution recognizes the special place of cooperatives in the development of the country. The consortia and federations of cooperatives have the capability of importing and distributing gas, fuel and other energy sources to servicetheir members.  They have resources in their possession that can enable them to put up gas station and to import gas from neutral energy producing countries. They can be responsible entities to be entrusted with gasoline distribution to their members. The life and death, the defeat and success of the ventures of cooperative could well depend upon their management of the source and distribution of oil/gas and oil products.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on COOPERATIVES DEVELOPMENT (SPECIAL CTTE.) since 1999-11-10
